findings.evidence: Besides, We engage offer-walls and mediators, including, but not limited to, Tapjoy, ironSource, Unity Ads, that may process Your personal data. We do not control the scope of the personal data they process. They process your personal data in accordance with their privacy policy. Besides, they do not have the technical opportunity to delete Your personal data.
